premise.claim: On the base branch, a JindoFSX/JindoCache DataLoad whose JindoRuntime sets spec.imagePullSecrets still generates job values with only the controller env secret (IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS), while the runtime's own master/worker/fuse pods honor spec.imagePullSecrets — so a DataLoad on a private-registry runtime fails to pull its image (issue #6247 symptom, Jindo variant).
premise.evidence: Differential: harness contract test TestVerifyImagePullSecretsPriority and the PR's own TestDataLoadImagePullSecrets both FAIL on base (got [{env-secret}], want [{runtime-secret}]) and PASS on head; results/premise-differential-base.txt

findings.title: Runtime imagePullSecrets replace env default for Jindo DataLoad
findings.claim: genDataLoadValue uses runtime.Spec.ImagePullSecrets when set (replacing, not merging with, the env default) and keeps the env fallback when the runtime list is empty, in both jindofsx and jindocache.
findings.harnessBites: fails on base, passes on head (results/premise-differential-base.txt)

findings.title: Legacy 'jindo' engine impl still ignores runtime imagePullSecrets (coverage gap)
findings.claim: pkg/ddc/jindo (selectable via JINDO_ENGINE_TYPE=jindo, same JindoRuntime CRD; its runtime chart honors spec.imagePullSecrets) still builds DataLoad values from the env only, so the exact bug this PR fixes persists in the third Jindo engine.
findings.harnessBites: fails on head (reproduction); passes with the same one-line fix applied then reverted (results/f2-bites-check.txt)
findings.currently: reproduced on head — reviewer rates it a non-blocking gap (legacy engine), author may scope it out deliberately

findings.title: POSIX path switch is behavior-neutral on Linux
findings.claim: The filepath->path switch in NormalizeSubPath, UFSPathBuilder, and IsValidMountRoot changes no Linux-visible behavior; it fixes container-path semantics for non-Linux dev hosts only.
findings.harnessBites: passes identically on base and head on Linux (results/f3-base-vs-head.txt) — no regression, no behavior change

findings.title: Chart plumbing: generated values reach the DataLoad job pod
findings.claim: genDataLoadValue's YAML lands under dataloader.imagePullSecrets and the fluid-dataloader charts render it into the job pod spec.
findings.harnessBites: helm render PASS with secret, absent without (results/chart-render-*.yaml)

liveNote: L3 (live cluster) not run per round policy: create a JindoRuntime with spec.imagePullSecrets referencing a private registry, run a DataLoad, confirm the job pod carries the runtime secret (kubectl get pod -o jsonpath='{.spec.imagePullSecrets}').
